negative_control_description: Frame 0 is byte-identical to positive_controls/multi_color_identity's own frame 0 (correct: near_limb=index 3, far_limb=index 4). Frames 1-7 swap which colour near_limb/far_limb use (near_limb=4, far_limb=3) -- geometry/motion is unperturbed (matches the correct rig keypoints exactly, same as the positive fixture), so pose-fidelity IoU is unaffected by the swap; near_limb/far_limb boxes are always equal-area (mirror construction), so the swap exactly preserves the whole-frame palette histogram every frame. Rig evidence records the correct, unswapped per-frame keypoints. Caught by character_part_identity, which compares each frame against frame 0's own real per-part pixels.
